Name: Binning Skill - Wayback Pelican Town Recolor
Author: PixieTJ
Description:
I needed a recolor to match Binning Skill with Wayback PT or I would go crazy with the clash. Here you go! It's subtle, just the handles, but it's enough to know the difference in qualities. Any more just didn't look right.

Thank you to both Binning Skill and Wayback PT for awesome mods!

Downloads.Description: Drop into Binning Skill folder and overwrite. Alternately if using Mod Organizer, just put below both Wayback and Binning.
